gloss: here and there; all over the place; various places

definitions.gloss: here and there; all over the place; various places
definitions.explanation: Multiple scattered locations; used to describe something occurring or existing in many different places.

examples.japanese: あちらこちらに{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}であちらこちらに{出張|しゅっちょう}する。
examples.english: I travel here and there on business trips for work.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}なので、あちらこちらに{傷|きず}みが{目立|めだ}つようになってきた。
examples.english: Since it's an old building, damage has become noticeable here and there.

notes:
Formed by combining あちら (over there) and こちら (over here). Describes scattered or widespread distribution across multiple locations. The more casual equivalent is あっちこっち, which is common in everyday speech. Both expressions can function as nouns or adverbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あちらこちらに: in various places
- あちらこちらで: at various places
- あちらこちらを{回|まわ}る: to go around various places
- あちらこちらから: from various places

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あっちこっち: here and there — casual form of あちらこちら, more common in spoken language
- {方々|ほうぼう}: all around; everywhere — slightly more formal, emphasizes searching or moving around
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}: everywhere; all over — stronger emphasis on ubiquity
